- Exact Android/API, ROM, kernel, root implementation/fork and versions, ABI/page size:
- Module version/commit/digest and accessory/profile/backend:
- Reported state/reason and minimum reproduction:
- Expected safe behavior versus observed outcome:
- Preservation/recovery impact and sanitized evidence:
- Acceptance cases to establish support; unrun tests and reason:
